paragraphs: Chapter 431
Episode 124. The Elders in Crisis (5)
The elders didn't take Jordan's words too seriously. They thought it was just something he said without any significant meaning, as he often did when he wanted to show his authority.
"Ha ha, who dares to say that we are becoming obsolete? Elder Jordan."
"Of course, that won't happen, but whatever it is, we are all ready to follow Elder Jordan's will."
"Yes, that's right! If Elder Jordan wishes, I would even consider returning to active duty right away..."
As the elders fell into their usual pattern, Jordan's gaze turned cold. He was fed up with their empty responses, devoid of any sincerity.
"Really? You all know my heart well. There's no need for you to return to active duty. However, as I just said... We will start a war with the 2nd and 12th generations from now."
From that moment, the elders realized that something was wrong.
"Elder Jordan, by war, do you mean...?"
"Literally. We will start by cleaning up the power of the 12th generation among the 2nd and 12th generations."
"What do you mean?"
"City of Tichan."
At the mention of that name, the elders' expressions hardened.
"That place is the most important stronghold of the 12th generation, and the people inside are their most trusted allies."
"Do you mean you will attack Tichan?"
"Yes."
"But, Elder Jordan, isn't there a fact that you might have forgotten?"
"Tichan is a place that no Runcandel can dare to invade."
-It's not fair, it's not right. It's just that I was a bit lucky. As soon as I arrived in Tichan, I had a connection with Casimir.
-Good, anyway, you passed the test. From today, no Runcandel can step on Tichan's land without your permission, even if it's this Siron Runcandel.
-Thank you, Father.
The conversation between Jin and Siron when Jin temporarily returned to the family after breaking the taboo during his reserve period.

At that time, Jin was able to secure the freedom of the base by passing Siron's test, and since then, Runcandel has never directly attacked Tichan, even if Jin caused any accidents. Even when the arrest warrant was issued at the end of the reserve period, the guardian knights could not visit Tichan directly.
The head's command is absolute. Since Siron has never withdrawn his command, Tichan was still a land where other Runcandels couldn't do anything without Jin.
"That's right. But there is a way. We can send people who are not Runcandel."
The elders couldn't help but widen their eyes once more.
"Elder Jordan, while that's not incorrect... In reality, isn't it just a play on words? The head would also forbid Runcandel from ordering a third party to attack Tichan."
"You're right, Elder Jordan. Moreover, we've all seen firsthand what could happen if we recklessly use external forces to attack the 12th generation..."
The elders seemed to feel a chill in the air as they recalled the moment Jin brought the supply of dead elders to them.

"Everyone seems to be burdened by fighting the 12th generation. Well, those who follow my orders are merely playing word games by defying the master's order. However, how many times has the 12th generation deceived us with those word games?"
Jordan was right.
During his time as a reserve, Jin had broken the rules several times, using his cunning to gain rewards instead of punishment.

"We must do the same. We've reached the point where there's no solution in a head-on battle. I've said it clearly, there's no such thing as a safe fight anymore. Those who are afraid can leave, but they must put down the mantle of being an elder of Runcandel."
For a moment, most of the elders recalled their younger days with Jordan. Even before leading the Black Sword Association, he had conspired to eliminate those who opposed him.
In the early days of becoming the chairman of the Black Sword Association, he carried out a bloody purge for several years.
In other words, if they chose to put down their mantle and leave here, it meant that their necks would eventually fall under the Black Sword Association's blade.
"The 12th generation... they haven't experienced much death of those around them yet. As the head of a family, let's make them realize that pain."
Jordan continued.
"...Elder, then who do you plan to send as a sacrifice?"
Somewhere in an unnamed desert in the eastern part of the post-Kascal Empire.
As Jordan and the elders planned their attack, Jin and some of his colleagues were tracking the runaway elders of the Ghost Legion.
"I never imagined that the Seigal family would have a secret fortress in such a remote place. The fact that the runaway elders have been in contact with them as well."
Lata said, sitting next to Jin who was in disguise, drinking tea at a nearby village restaurant.
The Seigal family.
Once the leading family of the Ghost Legion, they had been mostly killed by Smarion Procci and had fallen into ruin.
However, having ruled the Ghost Legion for centuries, the Seigal family hid their last remaining strength in this desolate, small desert.
By combining the intelligence of the Seven Color Birds and the Ghost Legion, they discovered this desert even before the truce had passed.
"Has it been confirmed that the traitors leaked the secrets of the Ghost Palace to outsiders?"
Lata nodded heavily.
"Yes. But we haven't confirmed which side the information was given to among Beimont, Ziple, Kinzelo, and other forces."
"We'll find out from now on. How large is the remaining Seigal family in the fortress?"

"Excluding servants, there aren't many combatants. However, before my father became the head of the family, there were the sacred brothers Roks and Laks Seigal, as well as several other prominent figures. The elders are not dull either."
Roks and Laks Seigal were names Jin had seen several times in books about war history. They were figures who would have easily become the head of the Ghost Legion if it weren't for Smarion.
Although they had been hiding without any presence for a long time, if they hadn't completely given up their swords, they would still be formidable opponents.
"Wait here, and my subordinates and I will take care of it."
"No, let's go together. We need to assess our allies' strength and coordinate with them."
Fei set up a perimeter with the members while Jin, Lata, and some group leaders decided to attack the fortress.
"Be careful not to destroy anything inside, as there might be important information. If possible, suppress them quickly and quietly."
"Yes, my lord."
"Also, if there are any civilians, they should all be considered rescue targets. Do not kill them just because they are annoying."

Unlike noble martial artists or royals, mercenaries often dealt with situations like this. If they encountered civilians who wouldn't make them money during a mission, they would kill them to avoid trouble.
However, now that the Ghost Unit was no longer just a group of mercenaries, they had to follow the customs of a prestigious family since they were under Jin's command.
"We will keep that in mind."
Soon after, Fei signaled that the perimeter was complete, and Jin, Lata, and the group leaders stealthily entered the dimly lit desert.
The last stronghold of the Seigal family was an underground fortress.
They accumulated wealth by trafficking drugs and various black market goods and dreamed of overthrowing the Prochi siblings and reclaiming the Ghost Unit with the help of the traitorous elders.
As Jin felt an unusually hard sensation underfoot in the middle of the soft sand, he realized it was the entrance to the underground fortress.
As they swept away the sand to check the door, a voice called out.
"Who's there?"
Although no guards were stationed outside the secret fortress, someone was always waiting behind the door.
Before the man could question the group's identity again, a leader threw a poisoned dart above the door.
Thump! With a small noise, a brief tremor came from the other side of the door and stopped quickly.
It was the tremor of the doorman's dying scream. Afterward, another leader used a specially made explosive, unique to the Ghost Unit, to silently blow off the lock.
True to their reputation as one of the two major mercenary groups in the world, they were specialized in infiltration.
As they entered, a vast space was revealed. It felt like looking at a giant ant's nest, and they soon encountered the remnants of the Seigal family.
"Intrud...!"
No one was able to finish warning the others about the intruders inside. Everyone's throats were cut by Jin and the Ghost Unit's swords, and they couldn't even leave behind a dying scream.
Jin spared only one person, giving him a brief opportunity to speak.
"Please, spare me. I'm just a hired mercenary."
"Where are the Seigal brothers?"
"In the innermost room in the center... Please."
Although Jin had no direct grudge against him, and the man obediently told them the location of the Seigal brothers, he was not a significant threat and really just a hired mercenary.
Jin did not spare him.
Although he preferred to avoid unnecessary killing, Jin was not a soft-hearted person who would show mercy even to the enemy soldiers.
Thump! As Jin ended his life, the group leaders following him nodded internally.
'I was worried that he might appear soft-hearted after saying we should save civilians.'
'There's no way our captain would have pledged loyalty to a fool. We don't need to worry in the future.'
Jin wiped the blood off his blade and signaled the group leaders.
"From here, let's split up. Lata and I will go to take care of the Seigal brothers, while the leaders search the remaining areas."
"Understood."
The leaders dispersed, and Jin and Lata quickly and quietly moved towards the Seigal brothers' hideout.
As the two were exceptionally skilled, most of the people they encountered on their way did not even realize their presence before meeting death.
Finally, upon reaching the last room, they came face-to-face with the armed Seigal brothers.
"Lata Prochi, you...!"
"How did you find out about this place?"
Lata didn't answer but instead twirled his twin swords lightly.
"Fine, so it ends like this. But do you think you can face us alone?"
"Come on!"
They completely disregarded the assumption that the man standing next to Lata, Jin, was an even more skilled warrior.
And so, Rok Seigal focused entirely on Lata's movements and soon experienced the humiliation of having his leg cut off.
